note: 硬规则。前六条是 PolicyEngine 权限连续性，由 ScenarioIntegrationTest / AuthorityContinuityTest 导出。后四条是沙箱权威的离线 ACS：无票据拒绝、票据不能第二次启动进程、无票据不出凭据、sandbox_refuse 必须进入 TraceStore。PolicyEngine 仍是唯一 allow/ask/deny。单参数工具旁路（sandbox_path=bypass）不能记为通过。缺任何一条时 ACS 为 null，不当作 0 分通过。scripted 通过不能晋升，也不把 shadow 改成 enforce。Harness 接到 SandboxedTool 之前，这四条用 SandboxStack / TicketIssuer / CredentialProxy 证明。

cases.statement: Approving one pending write does not authorize the next write.
A plaintext user turn cannot resume a pending confirmation.
Irreversible and unknown writes never auto-execute on a confident Jev score.
Ride cancellation stays on the human track even when Jev is confident.
NaN, infinite, or out-of-range Jev probabilities fall back to a human.
After the user denies the pending write, executions of that write stay zero.
A reversible write, an irreversible write, or a subprocess with no execution ticket is refused and does not count as an effect success.
One execution ticket cannot start a second process. An admitted write observation carries that ticket id.
CredentialProxy releases no token unless a live ticket permits that credential. The refusal is not an egress event.
A sandbox refusal appends a sandbox_refuse event to TraceStore. A missing audit is not a pass.
